basic_details.short_information: Veer Narmad South Gujarat University (VNSGU) has released the official Temporary Assistant Professor Notification 2026 at https://vnsgu.ac.in/. A total of 2 vacancies have been announced under the VNSGU Temporary Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026. Candidates possessing a Master's degree or Ph.D. in Chemistry or an allied subject as per UGC norms are eligible to attend the walk-in interview on 04 August 2026. The official notification PDF and walk-in interview details are available on the official website.

Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for VNSGU Temporary Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for VNSGU Temporary Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Temporary Assistant Professor posts at Veer Narmad South Gujarat University is scheduled for 04 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Temporary Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree or Ph.D. in Chemistry (Organic, Inorganic, Physical, Analytical) or an allied subject, as per UGC norms, to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Temporary Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Temporary Assistant Professor position at Veer Narmad South Gujarat University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Temporary Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Temporary Assistant Professor position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the VNSGU Temporary Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the VNSGU office. The specific address is Veer Narmad South Gujarat University, University Campus, University Road, Surat, Gujarat - 395007.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Temporary Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job for the post of Temporary Assistant Professor at Veer Narmad South Gujarat University.
